chapter: Blues, church and the call to music
title: Moon Glow with Martin on the radio and Lady Day
summary: As a boy he hears Lady Day, Pres and Bird on a New Orleans radio show under his pillow and feels called to New York.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: I just know that what I... and then the other thing was as a little boy in Memphis, I would put the radio under my pillow, and I would hear a station from New Orleans called Moon Glow With Martin.

And he’d be playing Lady Day and prayers and Bird and all that stuff, so I would hear all that stuff coming on, and I’d have to wait ‘til midnight or something. I wouldn’t sleep because I had to hear those elixirs, you know, because I knew what that was. Phineas had turned me on to Relaxing in Camarillo and stuff, and so modernity was calling me, and then prayers had this sound and then Lady Day was just singin’ only to me. Sure, she was singing directly to me!

So, I knew that I was being called and I would tell people, “I gotta leave and get on up to New York and marry her, and take care of her.” And they said, “Well why don’t you get out of here?” I said, “I can’t reach the clutch pedal yet!” You know, I mean, I was a little boy!
But I knew what was going on.
